notes: Each phase is filtered by Worker name, deployed version and its own time window.
Means use summed invocation CPU divided by observed requests; percentiles are not substituted for a mean.
API schema says startupCpuTimeUs is not included in cpuTimeUs and is attributed once to the first completed invocation on an isolate. A conservative including-startup estimate is separate.
Exact and whole-second windows are alternative boundary checks, not extra requests or independent observations.
Adaptive metrics can lag or be sampled; exact request-plan matching is reported. These estimates are not invoice totals.
Source-only profiling keeps auth/index caches and forces source range reads. Fully cold profiling bypasses all application caches; neither controls physical R2 internal caches.
Only the final shared-auth-cache version and the49-call time window are included. Earlier profiler, placement and109-call traffic are excluded.
Actual auth-tier and KV receipts must be used. EDGE or MEMORY hits reportKV0; no KVread count is inferred from desired behavior.
Runtime, index/auth and source-auth warmups remain separate from the four measured phases.
Sampling and exact request count agreement are checked perphase. Count agreement alone is insufficient if adaptive sampleInterval exceeds1.
queryFields: sum { requests errors cpuTimeUs startupCpuTimeUs subrequests } quantiles { cpuTimeP50 cpuTimeP95 cpuTimeP99 memoryUsageBytesP99 wasmMemoryBytesP99 } avg { sampleInterval } confidence(level:0.95) { sum { requests { estimate lower upper sampleSize isValid } cpuTimeUs { estimate lower upper sampleSize isValid } } }
